custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test with Min 4 and Max 10, 5 in bin location A and 0 in bin location B, so it has a positive and a second bin.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425665 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425665-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 4 in Min and 10 in Max, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, click Add Bin Location, pick a second bin location in the new row and type 0 in its Quantity, click Default on that second row, then click Save.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line from bin location B while it holds 0, so bin location B goes to -2: on its positive bin (5) part A sits between Min and Max, on the net (3) it would be below Min.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425665 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. On the work order's Lines tab, in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425665-A in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 2 in Qty *, then click Save.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is not listed under Under-supplied: the net 3 is not used by the Supply filter.

Step 2:

  • Part A is listed under Well-supplied, because its positive bin (5) lies between Min 4 and Max 10.
